title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 7B: Transport opinions
subtitle: Transport adjectives (opposites), metro and bus words, and opinions from the lesson

words.sent: The new metro is very ___. It takes only ten minutes to the city centre.
The bus was so ___ that I was late for school.

words.def: not dangerous; you will not get hurt
words.sent: I like cycling on this road because it is quiet and ___.
Don't ride a scooter without a helmet. It's ___.
I always get a seat because the train is ___ at six in the morning.
I don't like the metro at 8 a.m. It's so ___.
Sorry, we can't get on this bus. It's ___.

words.def: pleasant to sit in; making your body feel good
words.sent: Alex's car is big and ___. He can sit in it for hours.
The seats on this old bus are hard and ___.

words.def: not costing a lot of money
words.sent: A bus ticket is only 7,000 dong. It's very ___.
A taxi from the airport is ___, so I take the bus.
The trains in Tokyo are always very ___.
I don't like this bus. The windows are ___.

words.def: all the cars and buses on a road
words.sent: I was late because of the ___. There were cars everywhere.

words.def: a train system under the ground in a big city
words.sent: Svetlana goes to work on the ___ because it's quick.

words.def: a place where trains or buses stop for passengers
words.sent: The Moscow metro ___ looks like a palace.

words.def: a bus that goes fast and stops only at a few places
words.sent: In Cape Town, the ___ has its own road.

words.def: the time you spend going from one place to another
words.sent: The ___ from my house to the office takes about an hour.
I love the Moscow stations. I think they're ___.
Alex doesn't like the metro stations. He thinks they're ___.

translate.vi: Tôi thích đi tàu điện ngầm vì nó nhanh.
en: I love going on the metro because it's fast.
I love going on the metro because it is fast.
I like going on the metro because it's fast.
I like going on the metro because it is fast.

translate.vi: Tôi ghét ngồi trong xe buýt đông người.
en: I hate sitting on a crowded bus.
I hate sitting in a crowded bus.
I hate sitting on crowded buses.
I hate sitting on the crowded bus.
The bus ticket is very cheap.
Bus tickets are very cheap.
A bus ticket is very cheap.
The bus tickets are very cheap.

translate.vi: Tôi không ngại lái xe trong giờ cao điểm.
en: I don't mind driving in the traffic.
I don't mind driving in traffic.
I do not mind driving in the traffic.
I do not mind driving in traffic.

translate.vi: Những chiếc ghế trên xe buýt này không thoải mái.
en: The seats on this bus are uncomfortable.
The seats on this bus aren't comfortable.
The seats on this bus are not comfortable.
These seats on the bus are uncomfortable.

translate.vi: Đi xe máy ở đây rất nguy hiểm.
en: Riding a scooter here is very dangerous.
Riding a scooter here is dangerous.
It's very dangerous to ride a scooter here.
It is very dangerous to ride a scooter here.
